name: Switchboard
description: Lets the agents on this node talk to each other. Any agent can look up who else is here, leave one of them a message, and inspect the pair's bounded message history. A message is delivered at the start of the recipient's next turn, so delegation stays asynchronous and scoped to the calling agent. Works with every agent Ryu can run — the flagship agent, Claude Code, Codex, and any custom agent you have added — because it ships as ordinary tools rather than one agent's private feature.
tagline: Your agents can message each other

config.description: List the other agents on this node — their ids, names and what each one is for. Call this first when the user names an agent loosely or when you want to hand work to a specific agent. Returns `{ok, agents:[{id, name, description, model, engine}], count}`; the `id` is what agents.send addresses. Takes no arguments.

Leave a message in another agent's inbox and carry on — nothing waits. The recipient reads it at the start of its next turn. Use this to hand something over ("the deploy is done, your turn"), or to reply to a message you received. The sender is taken from the calling agent, not from anything you write. Returns `{ok, id, from, to, hops, delivery}`, or `{ok:false, refused:"hop_limit"}` when the relay chain is already at its limit.

to.description: The recipient agent's id, as listed by agents.directory.

text.description: The message. Write it so it stands alone — the recipient cannot see this conversation.

reply_to.description: Optional. The id of the message you are replying to, as it appeared in your inbox.

config.description: Read what you and another agent have already said to each other, or — with no arguments — list the agents you have exchanged messages with. Use it before asking again, so you do not re-ask something that was answered. Scoped to the calling agent: it can only ever show threads this agent is part of. Returns `{ok, agent, with, messages:[{seq, from, to, text}]}`, or `{ok, agent, peers}` when no peer is named.

with.description: The other agent's id. Omit to list every agent you have a thread with.
